summary: Deleting a claim no longer rebuilds the resource preparation of every subject in its batch: only a batch-mate whose rank can move (no stored position and no raw record, on a proof copy) is rebuilt

schema.detail: The trigger preparation_claims_dirty_DELETE is dropped at open and replaced by preparation_claims_dirty_delete_ranked, which marks a batch-mate's subject dirty only when the mate falls back to the arrival count. No table change.

rules.detail: No rule change. Preparation answers are unchanged: stored positions (claim_positions_sibling_delete_v1) already keep every mate's rank across a delete.

compatibility.detail: No wire or stored format change. An older binary opening the store adds the broader trigger back; both then run, which only marks more subjects dirty, and the next open of this build drops it again.

downtime.detail: None. One DROP TRIGGER and one CREATE TRIGGER at open.

recovery.detail: Revert the build: its open recreates the broader trigger.
